test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

You have _______ much but do not lose hope.
solution:
The correct answer is **Suffered.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options the correct option to be filled in the blank is **'suffered.'**
 
• **Suffered **means when someone goes through unpleasant things like pain, misery, trouble, etc.
 
 
• **Example: ***Citizens suffered a lot during the war.​*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Supported** means the act of helping someone by expressing your agreement with them, as well as occasionally providing them with material aid like money.
 
• **Stood** means being up and moving rather than sitting or lying down.
 
• **Settled** means to be comfortable, to feel like you belong, or to put an argument or disagreement to rest.
